parsed.explanation: Structural fix (1): The <TITLE> element was closed twice – once after 'versiegelte Buch' and again after 'verwechslen wird'. The second </TITLE> had no matching opening tag, which made the XML ill-formed. Since the passage beginning with 'worinnen die in der Offenbahrung Johannis ...' is the typical long explanatory subtitle of an 18th-century book title (the style of the period), the entire text belongs to one title. The premature first </TITLE> was therefore removed so that the whole title is enclosed in a single, well-formed <TITLE> element. Encoding fixes (9): The text contained mojibake resulting from UTF-8 being misread as Mac Roman ('√ü', '√§', '√º', '√∂'). These were restored to the intended characters: Hauß, Gespräch, flüchtigen, eröffnete, erkläret, tausend-jährige, göttlichen, Römischen, übrig. Other peculiarities such as the doubled 'Welt Welt', the historical spelling ('letsten', 'Liecht', 'Schtag-Uhr', 'GOtt'), and the tag name <PRIZE> were left unchanged, as they appear to be faithful transcription of the source or a deliberate schema choice, not XML errors.
